verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that code can be checked from the command line via `npx sv check`, and that Svelte works with .svelte.ts files. Neither shows that type checking reaches into component template markup rather than just script blocks. An older community comment notes IDE support issues but gives no concrete template type-checking failure. missing for 10: explicit documentation that sv check or the language tools type-check template expressions and props, editor integration evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of template type errors being caught at compile time.
